$description: Synapse glass/frosted surface tokens — defines the `.glass` utility class that Cerebro_frontend uses (Card/GlassPanel) but never defined. Values are DESIGNED (not extracted): a dark-first translucent surface derived from the TailAdmin dark palette, per the Synapse dark-first ops UI. Structure inspired by wedded's tokens/primitives/glass.json.

bg.$description: Translucent surface tint — boxdark #24303F at 72% opacity over the dark theme

border.$description: Hairline glass edge — bodydark #AEB7C0 at 14% opacity

blur.$description: Backdrop blur radius for glass surfaces
